en: I pay homage to Mahākāla, the bestower of all prosperity—dwarfish, pot-bellied, dark blue, and adorned with eight serpents. (1)
The hero has two arms and one face, with a skull as his crest-ornament;
he is girt with a tiger-skin and wears a garland of fifty severed heads.
O Lord of the World, salutations be to You, the Master who is the essence of all existence, who brings about the awakening of the world, and who is defined by both being and non-being.
Obeisance to you, Mahākāla, the dark-hued one of great splendor, the protector of accomplished adepts and practitioners, the Lord who wields the curved knife and the skull-cup. || 4 ||
O Mahākāla, who wears a tiger-skin garment, whose nature is great wrath, and who resembles twelve suns—salutations be unto you! (5)
O Mahākāla, salutations to you, whose face is formidable with great fangs, whose tongue lolls out, who is terrifying, and whose eyes have the appearance of deep red blood.
O Mahākāla, who wears a garland of human heads, adorned by the king of serpents, with a beard and a protruding belly, who are worthy of worship—salutations be to you! (7)
O Mahākāla, salutations to you, who have knitted brows, possess three eyes, and have tawny hair standing erect, resembling a mass of fire at the end of an eon.
O Mahākāla, who strikes terror into all the Daityas, who feeds upon bone, marrow, and flesh, and who is the protector of the devoted— salutations be unto you! (9)
O Mahākāla, who devours those who harass the mantra that accomplishes spiritual attainments and grants reassurance to the couple, homage be to you! 10.
O Mahākāla, you are the boat that travels alone upon the vessel of the journey to the further shore of the ocean of saṃsāra; salutations be to you, whose very essence is the boat-vehicle. 11.
Any devoted person who recites this hymn to Mahākāla is liberated from fear when afflicted by danger, and anxiety regarding enemies ceases.
Having paid homage to Mahākāla according to the prescribed birth of one's family, by that means one becomes well-born and devoted to all spiritual accomplishments. || 13 ||
